name: Golf Square
address: 8 Annastasia Way, Sunshine North, Victoria 3020, Australia

booking.howItWorks: Parties and events are booked by enquiry: fill in the enquiry form on the website or call (03) 9689 1888 / 1800 166 168 for a personalised quote.

packages.name: Bucks Party Package
packages.description: Golf simulators, food, drinks, darts and live sport. Pizzas, share plates, plus beers and wines included in the package.

packages.name: Birthday & Celebration Package
packages.description: Golf simulators, great food, drinks and plenty of competition, with interactive golf games, darts and live sports on the big screens.

packages.name: Children's Party
packages.description: All-in-one packages with easy-to-play games and tasty snacks for 10 or more. No golfing experience required.

packages.name: End-of-Year / Christmas Party
packages.description: Food, drinks and private golf bays with flexible packages for groups of 10-200. Quote on enquiry.

packages.name: Corporate Event
packages.description: Golf, games, food and drinks with full stage and AV setup for presentations, team building and celebrations. Spaces for 10-200. Quote on enquiry.
includes: Canapé, plated meal or classic bite options

faq.a: Ample and free, on-site parking is available for all guests, located just steps from the main entrance.

faq.q: Can I get there by public transport?
faq.a: We are located just 400m from Sunshine Train Station as well as major bus networks, and just off the M80 Ring Road near Ballarat Road.

faq.q: How many guests can you host?
faq.a: Event spaces for 10–200 guests. For whole-venue events: up to 600 standing, up to 350 theatre-style, up to 220 seated for formal dining.

faq.q: Do you have AV for presentations?
faq.a: Yes, a 12sqm raised stage with concert-quality speakers, plug-and-play AV, microphone inputs, 2 giant LED screens and large display screens on request.
